The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7cc30ddbfd4419f1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (Uz) be nonnegative fields whose depen- dence range is uniform in a possible law index n, and suppose supn,z P(Uz > t) ≤ p(t). Then, for T ≥ 0, E sup π∈PL X z∈π Uz1{Uz>T} ≤ C(L + 1)  T q p(T) + Z ∞ T q p(t) dt  . (12.3) In particular, a uniform bound P(Uz > t) ≤ At−4 for t ≥ 1 gives CA(L + 1)/T for T ≥ 1.
